text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is here, but...
Марузенски is not.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I see just a flicker of hesitation in Grass
Wonder's
eyes, and then she's back to
acting her prim,
practiced self.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, now that all the preparations are
complete,
it's about time.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I glance at her feet and notice she has
her
training shoes on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you change into your racing cleats?

text_block_list.text:
M-my apologies. I'll put them on right
away.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Without Марузенски's footsteps to
follow, Grass
Wonder looks unsure
where to go.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even so, the crowd roars—for the gates
must
open, and the Arima Kinen must go
on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hello there, Sei. How are you feeling?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Decent, I guess? Same old, same old.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Hehe. So you're in peak condition, then.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I should be off as well.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
